fields.Proficiencies:
Human
You gain +1 in the main stat of your choice and +1 in the substat of your choice.
You gain +5 skill points in any non-crafting or gathering skill of your choice.
You can speak, read and write Common, as well as another Language of your choice. You also gain proficiency in one common weapon group.
Chosen Extra Language: Sorthen
Chosen Common Weapon Group: Small Weapons

Rogue (Tier 1)
Roles: Striker
Heart: You gain +1 to Cunning.
Soul: You gain +1 to Focus or Agility.
Skills: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Appraise, Athletics, Stealth, Deception, Roguecraft, Perception, Insight, Negotiation, Intimidation or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
Key Ability: Rogue's Journey

Mage (Tier 1)
Roles: Utility, Controller
Heart: You gain +1 to Reason
Soul: You gain +1 to either Focus or Power.
Skills: You gain +5 skill points to spend on Appraise, Medicine, Magic, Religion, History, Flight, Artifice or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
Key Ability: Mage's Journey

Resolved Class Benefits
Rogue: Small Weapons proficiency.
Rogue: +1 Focus from Soul.
Rogue class: Stealth +5 skill
Rogue key ability: Roguecraft +5 skill
Mage key ability: Magic +5 skill

Starting Funds
Base Clim: 3000

Armor (Light)
Equipment | Armor | 500 Clim | 1
Increases your Guard by 1 and your Block by 4, but reduces your Initiative by 1 and your Evasion and Dodge by 2.
Mods:
A modsAgile Weave (35 points): No armor penalty, but no guard/block bonus. You gain +1 evasion (but no additional dodge). This also takes up your Frame mod slot.
Acrobat's Harness (10 points): You gain +10 bonus to athletics while wearing this armor.
Camo (10 points): Pick a color theme. You gain +5 to stealth when hiding in environments of that theme, but -5 when hiding elsewhere. A GM may approve new environments, defaults are: green camo (jungle, woodland, prone in grass), yellow camo (desert, savannas), white camo (snow, arctic), dark camo (night, caves, rocky terrain), blue camo (rivers or oceanic)
Porcupine Hide (10 points): Enemies grappling you take 1d6 full pierce damage. When escaping a grapple, you also deal 1d6 full pierce damage to the creature grappling you.

B modsSleek (25 points): If you spend RP dodging an attack of opportunity, you may dodge any other attacks of opportunity made in reaction to the same action at the first for free.
Padded (25 points): Increase guard vs light attacks by 1, doesn't affect heavy damage.
Mistweave (50 points): You no longer provoke attacks of opportunity, but all attacks against you gain Half Pierce.

Small Weapons (One-Handed)
Equipment | Weapon | 500 Clim | 1
Hidden Weapon: You may draw this weapon for 0 AP. Each combat, after you draw the weapon if the next attack you make that round is using this weapon and is a basic Light or Heavy attack, it gains the Trick Attack keyword. After benefiting from this bonus, you cannot do so again the same combat even if drawing a different weapon with this ability.
Mods
A mods:Aerodynamic Design (10 points): Boomerang/Return effects cannot be used with this. For 1 RP you can throw the dagger, making a light ranged attack. On damage, the target is slowed until the end of its next turn.
Spring-loaded (20 points): You do not need to draw and wield this weapon to use it, it is worn in your equipment. However, you can only attack once per round with it. If your first attack with it in a fight is a basic attack, it activates Hidden Weapon as if you drew it right before attacking, though this still does not allow you to benefit from Hidden Weapon multiple times per combat. This weapon can no longer be used to make thrown weapon attacks and cannot be drawn normally. Designed by Nya.
Compact Ergonomics (20 points): When your other hand is free and you take a movement action that costs RP, that movement range is increased by 5ft.
Parrying Dagger (20 points): If you don’t use this weapon to make an attack during your turn, you gain a +4 Shield bonus to your Block until the start of your next turn. You also gain a +4 bonus to your ‘damage’ roll when using the Parry ability.
Flat Pommel (35 points): When your other hand is free, you use your free hand to push the blade into targets increasing melee heavy attack damage to 5d6.

B mods:Poisoner Weapon (25 points): Applying poison to this weapon costs -1 AP (min 0).
Butterfly Knife (50 points): Your first light attack each round with this weapon gains Trick Attack, but it can no longer make Heavy attacks.
Ring Pommel (50 points): If you make a heavy attack that the target defends against, you do not trigger attacks of opportunity from them until the start of your next turn.

Wand (One-Handed)
Equipment | Channeling Weapon | 500 Clim | 1
Magic Blast: You may alter the damage type fired by an attack made with this weapon for 0 AP. The damage type must be an element type you have mastered (usually unlocked through classes) or one that’s built into the weapon. Each weapon has at least one element built in.
Range: 60ft
Mods
A mods:Ornamental (10 points): You may use this weapon as one minor item such as an instrument or parasol.
Echo Blast (20 points): When you make a basic Heavy attack, you may split the damage against two different targets in range. Make only 1 accuracy check against both.
Warding Wand (35 points): You may spend 1 AP to gain 5 temporary HP until the start of your next turn.

B mods:Dedicated Focus (50 points): Gain +1 bonus to accuracy rolls, but can only fire elemental attacks of 1 element. Spells cast through this wand only gain that bonus if they deal that element of damage.
Mana Core (80 points): When you deal max damage with an attack made with this weapon or with a spell cast through this weapon against an enemy in an encounter, your next spell this turn costs 1 less mana (min 0)

Adventurer's Kit
Adventuring Essentials | Kit | 100 Clim | 1
Adventuring kits contain all of the basic tools for adventuring. Included in the kit: Backpack, Flint and steel, Rope, Notebook, Pen, Compass, Bedroll, Torches, Hand Mirror.
Effect: You can use the items for their various purposes within reason. Can store up to 5 burden of Adventuring Essentials, a Northi Lantern or items included in this kit in a combat ready state for 0 burden and contains a torch/lantern holster for hands off torch/lantern use for light purposes. Cannot store kits or other burden reducing items in this combat ready state.

Smoke Flask
Alchemy | Flask | 250 Clim | 1
An Alchemical mix that creates a cloud of smoke temporarily. May be thrown up to 20ft away. Creates a smokecloud in a 15x15ft area that blocks line of sight. This effect functions similarly to ‘Glittershards’ and ends at the start of your next turn.
Crafting:
Materials: 200 Alchemy Materials
Herbs:
1x Rare Wind

Military Ration
Adventuring Essentials | Basic | 40 Clim
A ready to eat meal. Grants the effects of food for rest without having to cook or prepare anything. Can be consumed during a rest to gain the effects of food (2 mana).

Typically consists of of dried meats, dried fruits and blocks of compressed grains with honey. Sometimes includes vials of sauce. Typically pressed together and then rolled in linen cloth, but higher end ones can come in wooden boxes.
If eaten during an encounter, it's a Setup action that takes 8 AP to complete.
fields.Name: Live Human Sneak Thief Used

quickBuild.summary:
Sneak Thief applied for Human.
Character start: Standard Play.
Built to sneak, solve problems, and strike from advantage. Focus and Cunning support stealthy play.
Class plan: Rogue mastery (800 EXP), Mage key + 1 learned ability (200 EXP) = 1000 EXP.
Human can use every class and item in this package; no fallback is required.
Mastered Rogue is the strongest immediate thief foundation. Spending the remaining 200 EXP on Mage and Decipher Magic is better than a bare Scout key because it adds magical investigation and completes Thief's prerequisites; Thief can then be unlocked with the next 200 class EXP.
Gear package: Armor (Light), Small Weapons (One-Handed), Wand (One-Handed), Adventurer's Kit, Smoke Flask, Military Ration.
Auto-equipped loadout: Armor (Light), Small Weapons (One-Handed), Wand (One-Handed), Adventurer's Kit. Consumables remain carried for use.
